onbS1Eyebrow.message: The part of every link you never see

onbS1Title.message: Every link you click hides a tracker you never asked for.

onbS1Lede.message: Newsletters, social shares, ads. Almost every link carries a string of tracking parameters like utm_source, fbclid, and gclid. They ride along in your address bar, in your history, and in anything you copy and forward.

onbS1Pt.message: CleanLink strips that trail automatically, on every site, the moment a page starts loading.

onbS1FieldRevealsValue.message: the newsletter you're on, the campaign, sometimes the ad that led you here

onbS2Title.message: CleanLink removes the tracking before you even notice.

onbS2Lede.message: CleanLink rewrites the address with a browser-level rule the instant a page starts loading. No script runs on the page, and nothing about the link is sent anywhere to make it happen.

onbS2DemoBtn.description: Step 2 button that replays the before/after clean demo

onbS3Eyebrow.message: Ten seconds, then never touch it again

onbS3Title.message: Pin the icon and keep the shield in view.

onbS3Lede.message: The cleaning already runs in the background. Pinning CleanLink puts the on and off switch, the per-site allowlist, and Copy clean link one click away instead of buried in the extensions menu.

onbS3Pt.message: Nothing here changes what gets cleaned. It keeps the control within reach.

onbS3Row1Text.message: It sits at the right of the address bar, next to the profile icon.

onbS3Row3Title.message: Click the pin and keep it in your toolbar.

onbS3Row3Text.message: The icon moves into the toolbar and stays there.

onbS3PinnedNote.message: Pinned. The icon now lives in your toolbar.
onbS3PinnedNote.description: Step 3 confirmation text shown after pinning is acknowledged

onbS4Eyebrow.message: How CleanLink keeps every link clean

onbS4Title.message: A browser rule strips the tracker before the page loads. Nothing leaves your device to protect it.

onbS4Lede.message: The strip happens through Chrome's own declarativeNetRequest rule, evaluated in the browser before the request goes out. No proxy sits between you and the site, and the raw address never has to leave your machine to get cleaned.

onbS4StatLocalLabel.message: the rule runs in your browser, not on a server

onbS4StatZeroLabel.message: setup steps needed, protection starts on install

onbS4Pt.message: CleanLink is built and maintained by one developer at Zovo who answers support requests directly.

onbS4Trust1Title.message: CleanLink keeps everything on your device

onbS4Trust1Text.message: The redirect rule and the clipboard copy both run locally. No dashboard, no analytics pixel, nothing logged about which links you clean.

onbS5Eyebrow.message: The honest trade, no catch here

onbS5Title.message: Free keeps cleaning forever. Pro removes the caps.

onbS5Lede.message: The core tracker list runs unlimited on the free plan, every visit. Pro adds the extended list, unlimited allowlist, and unlimited copy-clean. Take it monthly, cancel anytime, or pay once and keep it for good.

onbS6Lede.message: Pin the icon, and Copy clean link is one right-click away on any page. Here's the quick reference for what CleanLink does on its own and what's still in your hands.

onbS6DevNote.message: I maintain this one alone, so a bug report goes straight to me instead of a queue. Write to support@zovo.one or find me on GitHub if something breaks.
